A book to return to

I found Design Patterns a rewarding read, particularly at a stage where I have enough practical experience to recognize some of the problems and still plenty to learn about solving them.

Its lasting value, for me, is the connection between recurring problems, design intent, and the consequences of a solution. Those connections give me something to return to as I encounter different systems and constraints.

Finishing the book leaves me with a useful exercise: revisit a past design, describe the problem more clearly, and consider which patterns would have helped—and why.

Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
